title: Agent Skills, Explained: What They Are and How They Differ From MCP
description: Agent Skills became a vendor-neutral standard on 22 October 2026. Here is what a skill is, how agents load them without filling their context, and where they fit next to MCP.

title: Do AI Agents Need a Memory System? What Two New Papers Found
description: MemoryTax found that a strong model searching its raw history beat memory frameworks, and TurnCost found that an agent's bill grows with its turns, not with the size of tool output.

title: How US Healthcare Works, Part 1: Members, Patients, Providers and Payers
description: Who the players in US healthcare are, how many of each there are, and how money and information move between them when someone sees a doctor.

title: How US Healthcare Works, Part 2: Public and Private Coverage
description: Medicare and its four parts, Medicaid and CHIP, employer plans, the ACA marketplaces and the military and veterans' systems: who each one covers, who pays for it, and how it reaches providers.

title: From Image Classifiers to H-JEPA: Learning by Predicting What Matters
description: How vision models went from needing a label on every image to world models that plan by predicting in their own representation space, and what the new H-JEPA paper adds.
